findings.failure_path: The collection loop includes both <session>.jsonl and <session>. If only a non-empty regular file named <session> exists, real becomes true and the file enters transcripts. make_record now accepts any non-empty transcripts list, so an otherwise successful run counts as valid without a <session>.jsonl transcript. Regrade preserves that false validity.
findings.smallest_fix: Require source.name == f"{session}.jsonl" as well as the non-symlink, non-empty regular-file checks. Add a bare UUID regular-file case asserting transcript_missing before and after regrade.

findings.failure_path: An older record produced from a session directory alone contains run.transcripts = ["transcript-<UUID>"] and transcript_missing. regrade passes that old list directly into make_record. Replacing the suffix check with list truthiness removes transcript_missing and can promote the sample to valid. Older directories named <UUID>.jsonl also retain their false validity because no migration verifies the saved artifact.
findings.smallest_fix: Distinguish records containing the new classification from legacy records. Refuse legacy persistence evidence or reclassify its saved artifacts using the exact filename, type and size requirements. Add a regression that regrades records in the previous format.
